GISS-E3-G (2020): 
aerosol: Varies with physics-version (p==1 none, p==3 OMA, p==4 TOMAS, p==5 MATRIX)
atmos: GISS-E3 (Cubed sphere, C90; 90 x 90 x 6 gridboxes/cubeface, grid resolution aligns with longitude/latitude along central lines for each cubeface; 102 levels; top level 0.002 hPa)
atmosChem: Varies with physics-version (p==1 Non-interactive, p>1 GPUCCINI)
land: GISS LSM
landIce: none
ocean: GISS Ocean (1 degree; 360 x 180 longitude/latitude; 32 levels; top grid cell 0-10 m)
ocnBgchem: none
seaIce: GISS SI
